name: aasb-aas-devops-cloud
description: Install the "AAS DevOps & Cloud" workflow plugin from Agentic Awesome Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Ship infrastructure, deployments, CI, environments, rollback plans, troubleshooting, and incident-ready operations.
interface.longDescription: Ship infrastructure, deployments, CI, environments, rollback plans, troubleshooting, and incident-ready operations. Prepare infrastructure and delivery changes with validation, rollback steps and explicit deployment boundaries. Recommended for: Platform teams, Startup engineers owning deployment, Cloud and DevOps maintainers. Not for: An active incident as the primary task: use Observability IR, Cloud accounts, credentials or managed infrastructure supplied by the plugin. Covers Docker Expert, AWS Serverless, and 8 more skills.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the deployment target, infrastructure and CI configuration. Prepare the requested change using the existing platform, validate it locally where possible, and provide rollout, rollback and post-deployment checks. Keep production changes for the authorized deployment step.
Use this plugin to design a small-team cloud deployment plan with Terraform, CI, and runbook steps.
Use this plugin to troubleshoot this failed deployment and prepare an incident response checklist.
